questions.q: What is the first rule of a first freewriting session?
How long should a freewriting session last?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a time limit of 5 to 20 minutes will do.

questions.q: What should you do while freewriting, per rule two?
a: Write fast and don't stop or edit
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to write quickly, never edit or question.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 say about lying in freewriting?
a: You should, as an exercise in creativity
questions.why: Lesson 2 encourages exaggerating and flipping facts.

questions.q: How could freewriting help you write a book, per lesson 3?
a: Five minutes a day adds up to many pages in a year
It helps you find a publisher
questions.why: Lesson 3 says daily short writing can produce 60 to 150 pages.
